settings.heading: Details
settings.body:
Gold-plated brass, nickel-free. Hand-set stones.
Made in: India

settings.heading: Care Guide
settings.body: Keep away from water, perfume and direct sunlight. Store separately in the pouch provided. Polish gently with a soft, dry cloth.

settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.body: Ships within 2–3 business days. Easy 7-day returns on unworn, undamaged pieces in original packaging.

settings.heading: Delivery information
settings.body: Dispatched in 2–3 business days. Free shipping across India.

settings.heading: Secure payment
settings.body: UPI, cards, net banking and cash on delivery.

settings.name: Ananya R.
settings.title: Wore it through three functions
settings.body: The pearls have a warm, uneven shape that photographs beautifully. Clasp held through a full wedding day and the chain has not tarnished after two months of regular wear.

settings.name: Meera K.
settings.title: Heavier than it looks, in a good way
settings.body: Sits well over both silk and cotton. I ordered the 18 in and it falls exactly where I wanted. The kundan accents are hand-set, you can see it up close.

settings.name: Divya S.
settings.title: Beautiful, sizing runs long
settings.body: Lovely piece and the finish is genuinely good. I would size down to 16 in if you want it at the collarbone. Shipping took three days.
